purpose: Final sound portrait: new relaxed youthful athletic woman with olive skin and small earbuds

steps.prompt:
Create a BRAND NEW photorealistic portrait, not a variation of any earlier woman's face. Wide 2.4:1 landscape image for an audio website, genuinely transparent background. The only supplied reference shows the earbud DESIGN, not a human subject.

SUBJECT: one naturally attractive adult woman aged about 25, an athletic everyday woman with a medium warm OLIVE complexion and naturally dark CURLY hair loosely gathered into a high ponytail, with a few soft curls near her temples. She has a broad softly rounded nose, fuller youthful cheeks, an oval face with a gently defined jaw, natural dark brows, and softly rounded lips. This is a new distinct person. Show her centered from upper chest upward with healthy athletic shoulders, wearing a plain black performance crew-neck top with no logos. Face square to camera, head upright, CHIN LEVEL, BOTH EYES GENTLY CLOSED, a small easy closed-mouth smile. Relaxed forehead, jaw and shoulders. No upward head tilt, no dramatic pose.

Extremely authentic photographic SKIN DETAIL: real individual pores in the appropriate places, tiny freckles, fine vellus hairs, slight natural color variations in the cheeks, delicate lip texture, individual brow hairs and eyelashes. This is youthful skin, so no exaggerated forehead creases, wrinkled neck, leathery pattern or over-sharpened texture. Soft natural window-light quality with gentle shadows, no glossy glamour highlights, no airbrushed plastic appearance, no fake uniform grain. A convincing natural portrait made with a professional camera, not a synthetic beauty model.

PRODUCTS: exactly two VERY SMALL life-size wired earbuds float beside her head, one on each side at ear height. The ENTIRE earbud, including the curved wing, is only about HALF THE HEIGHT OF HER VISIBLE HUMAN OUTER EAR. Keep their design exactly as the reference: compact matte black oval/circular faceplate, narrow muted champagne perimeter, smoked translucent housing, plain curved black wing, smoky silicone tip, tiny champagne details on the inside, black braided cable. No old sunburst faceplate or gold pad on top of wing. Angle silicone tips inward toward her ears, outer faceplates partly toward camera. Each small earbud floats a few centimetres outside the corresponding ear. Fine black cables hang naturally toward her shoulders. No inline remote or USB connector in this crop. No giant devices.

SOUND WAVES: three or four smooth elegant flowing coloured curves bridge the gap from each earbud's silicone tip to its corresponding ear. Clearly visible blue/cyan through violet to pink, gentle rising/falling waveform shape, large enough to span the gap, thin translucent strands with space between them. No arrows, starbursts, laser beams, particles, broad glowing fog or loops around the head. Avoid covering skin or face with the waves.

COMPOSITION: wide horizontal 2.4:1 canvas. Complete head and hair plus upper torso, safely within frame. Head is about 65–70% of image height; person, both small earbuds and waves remain inside central 55% of canvas. Generous transparent space left and right. No text.

BACKGROUND: true transparent alpha in ALL empty space including behind her head and between sound-wave strands. No light halo, no gray glow, no coloured background, no studio wall, no solid rectangle, no fake checkerboard. Human and devices fully opaque, only wave strokes partially transparent. Clean realistic hair edges. Dark clothing fades gently into transparency at bottom. High native resolution with careful facial microdetail.

Precise image edit. Change ONLY the size of the two floating earbuds. Keep the woman, her face, closed eyes, olive skin detail, smile, curly hair, clothing, composition, image dimensions, colourful wave shapes and fully transparent background EXACTLY as they are.

The earbuds are still too large. Shrink EACH COMPLETE EARBUD (housing, faceplate, ear tip and curved wing together) to 40% of its CURRENT height and width. This must be a drastic visible reduction. Each earbud should appear tiny beside her head, about one third of the height of her visible human outer ear. At the supplied image resolution each complete earbud should occupy roughly 45 pixels in height rather than its current roughly 120 pixels. Do not shrink the head to compensate. Do not move the earbuds closer to camera. Preserve the exact existing matte-black/smoked-translucent product design and champagne rim at this smaller size.

Keep each earbud near its existing horizontal center at ear height. Let the same colourful sound waves bridge from the newly smaller silicone tips to her ears. Waves stay the same large, flowing blue/violet/pink curves; only adjust their starting point so they touch the smaller tips. The thin braided cables attach neatly to the smaller earbuds and hang downward naturally, with proportionally slim connectors.

Nothing else changes. Do not redraw or change her identity, features, hair, lighting, expression or clothing. Preserve the detailed youthful skin without adding wrinkle patterns or smoothing it. Maintain genuine transparent alpha with no halo or background.
